marcos: quick PR to add a short 'burst autoscale' example for Dedicated pools. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/599

jen: thanks — can you show both Terraform and Python SDK snippets? customers rarely convert between them.

marcos: added both. Terraform example uses a lightweight buffer pool and a target_rps fallback: ```hcl
resource "redwood_dedicated_pool" "burst_buf" {
  name = "burst-buffer"
  min_gpus = 0
  max_gpus = 6
  autoscale { mode = "burst"; burst_capacity = 2; target_rps = 1200; scale_cooldown = 60 }
}
```

kevin: tiny nit: prefer 30s cooldown for low-latency apps; mention tradeoffs. also remove any internal field names.

marcos: adjusted to 30s and dropped internals. Python snippet added and a note: CreatePool is async and returns operation id.

pr-bot: link-check passed; lint OK. ready for review.

jen: LGTM. merging in 15m unless objections.

marcos: thanks all :thumbsup:
